Chapter 386: Chapter 7 The Secret of the Supreme Being, That Segment of the Body (Please Subscribe) _2

…

“The location for comprehending that part of the body, is it in the Virtual World? Did nine of the supreme beings of our Human Civilization pay some price to replicate three-tenths of that body’s essence into the Virtual World?”

Lin Yuan, having received the information, silently thought to himself.

This was also to facilitate the Human Evolvers in their contemplation; otherwise, to comprehend that part of the body, one would have to travel to the Central Star Domain, which would take a long time.

However, the Virtual World simplifies many things.

One only needs to connect their consciousness to enter.

...

Half a day later.

Lin Yuan suddenly received an invitation.

“Would you like to enter Virtual World No. 124354?”

“Enter.” Lin Yuan immediately chose to agree.

To facilitate Human Evolvers in comprehending that part of the body, the Virtual World had specially opened up many worlds, distributing all evolvers across numerous worlds.

After all, with such a large number, it’s better to manage them separately.

Each world has a dedicaed manager to check the progress of each evolver’s contemplation.

Hum.

When Lin Yuan opened his eyes, he found himself at the top of a mountain peak.

Looking around, mountains surrounded him on all sides, and each peak was occupied by ten to twenty evolvers.

“Most are Seventh Rank Evolvers, with a minority being Sixth Rank, and there are even some Eighth Rank Evolvers?”

Lin Yuan took one glance and took in their various auras.

The first batch of Human Evolvers to contemplate that body part were essentially the geniuses of a Star Domain.

Like Lin Yuan, like the twelve disciples of the Chikun Star Lord.

And likewise, being geniuses, upon entering different comprehension worlds, a second division occurred.

Geniuses among geniuses like Lin Yuan, publicly under a hundred years old and already at Seventh Rank, would naturally be grouped with talents who ascended to the Seventh Rank between one hundred to a thousand years old.

“You are the Thirteen Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage, right?” At that moment, a voice came from nearby.

Lin Yuan glanced over; the speaker was a stalwart man, his physique as perfect as if sculpted, exuding an extreme sharpness just by standing there.

He was an Evolver from the Nine Swords Star Domain, named Gao Wufeng, the most valued disciple of the Nine Swords Star Master, who had stepped into the Seventh Rank at four hundred and thirty years old and now was at the peak of the Seventh-Rank King Level.

In terms of strength, this Gao Wufeng far surpassed the Great Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage.

“Yes, that’s me.”

Lin Yuan nodded. Now, the Evolvers able to contemplate that body part all started from the Sixth Rank, with no need to worry about assassination from different species, so there was also no need to hide one’s identity.

At the same time.

The other Evolvers on this mountain also began murmuring quietly among themselves.

“That’s the Thirteen Peak Master?”

“Is that the freak from the Chikun Star Domain who stepped into the Seventh Rank before the age of a hundred?”

“Indeed a freak… I have a special constitution and have awakened the Ancestral Bloodline, supported intensely by my family, yet I only reached the Seventh Rank at over six hundred years old. How exactly did this Thirteen Peak Master do it?”

“I heard that this Thirteen Peak Master doesn’t have any special constitutional bloodline enhancement.”

“Freakish, too freakish.”

…

The Evolvers able to participate in the first batch all hailed from significant backgrounds and were rare talents even within their own Star Domains, possessing considerable pride. However, upon seeing Lin Yuan, they harbored no thoughts of comparison.

After all, stepping into the Seventh Rank before the age of a hundred without any physical or bloodline enhancements was truly terrifying.

In terms of talent, Lin Yuan reckoned he might leave his name in the annals of Human Civilization.

“How much do you know about this contemplation session, Thirteen Peak Master?” Gao Wufeng from the Nine Swords Star Domain asked quietly on the side.

“My teacher mentioned it’s related to the Supreme Beings.” Lin Yuan said directly.

Since there was no need to hide this fact, the teacher of Gao Wufeng before him, the Nine Swords Star Master, also had combat power akin to the Chikun Star Lord, another invincible existence at the Eighth Layer.

“Supreme Beings…” Gao Wufeng sighed.

As pillars of the Human Civilization, who wouldn’t want to become the next Supreme Being?

“With your talent, Thirteen Peak Master, you should shine in this session,” Gao Wufeng said.

“It’s not that easy. After all, it’s a part of a Supreme Being’s body. If it were just about talent, there would have been no need to make it public,”

“Just let the batch with the highest talent and gifts comprehend it privately.”

Lin Yuan shook his head and said,

“Shisan Peak Master is right,” a woman with golden wings approached, her entire being enveloped in an infinite radiance, emanating a holy aura.

“Zuo Qiuguang?”

Gao Wufeng looked toward the woman with golden wings.

This woman, named Zuo Qiuguang, had awakened the Light Elf Bloodline.

The Elf Bloodline was an exceptionally powerful branch within the human bloodline system, especially adept at comprehending rules.

The Light Elf Bloodline had an innate affinity for the rules of light, and the concentration of Zuo Qiuguang’s bloodline was astoundingly high. Moreover, both her parents were high-priced Evolvers of the Human Civilization, who spared no effort in nurturing her.

Zuo Qiuguang stepped into the Seventh Rank when she was only 362 years old.

“Shisan Peak Master,” Zuo Qiuguang looked towards Lin Yuan, a smile appearing on her face.

Gao Wufeng also nodded slightly. In terms of innate talent, Zuo Qiuguang was even stronger than he was.

The three of them sat together, exchanging ideas, while other Evolvers on top of the mountain subconsciously kept their distance from them.

…

“Alright.”

Just then, a massive figure appeared under the sky, casting an indifferent glance at the Evolvers on numerous mountain peaks.

“Next, I need to remind you of a few things,”

“First, in this world, both your physical souls are standardized at the First Rank. Do not attempt to recover or synchronize your strength.”

“Second, regardless of which Evolution Path you comprehend from that segment of the body, do not cultivate it in reality, but first in the Virtual World.”

“Third, it’s forbidden to cultivate any Evolution Path other than what’s comprehended from that segment of the body.”

“Fourth, boldly seek to comprehend. Even if you die due to some accident, the Supreme Being will ‘resurrect’ you…”

After saying this, the massive figure ceased to speak.

At the mountain peaks, the Evolvers, hearing this, immediately started whisper discussions.

“It seems comprehending that segment of the body will be very dangerous,” Gao Wufeng said softly.

“Indeed,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Otherwise, they wouldn’t forbid practicing the Evolution Paths comprehended in reality, nor would there be resurrection by the Supreme Being if one unfortunately died.

Using the ‘resurrection’ trump card means it definitely won’t be smooth sailing.

“Wanting to become a Supreme Being, how could it not involve risks?” Zuo Qiuguang’s expression was filled with a fighting spirit. From a young age, she had been obsessed with cultivation, longing to become the strongest.

And in the Human Alliance, in the Cosmic Starry Skies, only a Supreme Being dares call themselves ‘the strongest’.”

“Alright.”

“Good luck.”

The massive figure under the sky disappeared.

In its place was a segment of a body.

For a moment, even the light seemed to dim.

All the Evolvers’ attention was focused on that body segment.

“Is that a part of a Supreme Being’s body?” Lin Yuan looked up as well.

As Lin Yuan observed the body segment, an invisible pressure began to suppress down, crushing his Spirit Will.

“What is this?”

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly.

Under this suppression, as the observation time elapsed, the oppression on Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will gradually intensified.

“Is this the power of a Supreme Being? Merely a fraction of a body, even a virtual copy, yet retaining only thirty percent of its power, can cause such great spiritual oppression to me?”

Lin Yuan marveled inwardly.

He glanced around at others, noticing they too wore serious expressions, enduring the natural spiritual oppression emitted by the body segment.

“However, this type of suppression is actually a good place to forge Spirit Will.”

Lin Yuan’s spirit stirred, even his teacher Chikun Starlord, far surpassing him in power,

couldn’t exert such immense pressure on Spirit Will.

“Perhaps with this suppression, my Mental Will Index could break through ten thousand points in a short period?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.
